implementation.reason: Core heatmap validates finite scores and its single-axis grammar omits strip and marginal means. Annotated-heatmap recipe assumes square partner matrix, binary metadata and selection. Neither contract fits this complete 8x9, three-condition matrix with explicit unmeasured cells. Custom vector cells, shared coordinates and measured-only bar means use physical-font/export primitives adapted from inspected render.py.
